issue.title: 'Failed to save the options: null' error when saving options in fresh install.

repository.name: zaproxy
repository.description: The ZAP by Checkmarx Core project

issue.body:
**Describe the bug**
'Failed to save the options: null' error when saving options in fresh install.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Download weekly build in zip file on Windows
2. Extract to some dir.
3. Use the following batch file to start ZAP using custom data dir location.

set jvmopts=-Xmx2048m -Dsun.java2d.noddraw=true
java %jvmopts% -jar "zap-2.9.0.jar" -installdir C:\\zaptest290weekly -dir C:\\zaptest290weekly\\data -host 192.168.0.2 -port 8080
4. Open Options menu
5. Click Ok without changing the defaults.


**Expected behavior**
Options are saved.

**Screenshots**
![%pn-2020-08-23-13-44-48](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29713984/90976567-e45d1b80-e546-11ea-83f1-d0bd2a25ff63.png)


**Software versions**
ZAP 2.9.0 w2020-08-17
OS: Windows 10 x64 2004
Java: Oracle JRE 1.8.0_251 both x32 x64

**Errors from the zap.log file**
[err.log.txt](https://github.com/zaproxy/zaproxy/files/5113834/err.log.txt)


**Additional context**
No errors if used config from other ZAP installation

**Would you like to help fix this issue?**
Yes.

issue.title: Catch NPE on panel level when saving/validating

repository.name: zaproxy
repository.description: The ZAP by Checkmarx Core project

issue.body:
Move the catch of the NullPointerException from the container panel to
the individual panels to still allow to validate/save other panels that
do not have issues.
Make the error generic now used for save/validate and provide the
details of the exception for easier report.

Related to #6136.
Improvement of #5306.

issue.title: fuzz: properly handle no default category selected
issue.body:
Check that the default category is selected (non-null) before using it.

Fix zaproxy/zaproxy#6136.
